column7: RevokeShare and ShareSecret notify the affected users AFTER the share write has committed. A CreateNotification panic escaped that step, so a committed revoke (row deleted, audit written) was answered with HTTP 500 (FuzzStorageFaultOperations oracle (a), REST DELETE /api/v1/shares/{id}, CreateNotification#1/panic, carried by a knownOpenTolerance). notifySecretShared, notifyGroupSecretShared, notifySecretShareRevoked and notifyGroupSecretShareRevoked now recover a panic via recoverPostCommitNotifyPanic (INV-CORE-34) and log it at SECURITY: WARN; the success response stands. Sweep of sharing.go, group_sharing.go, share_authz.go and secret_ownership.go found no other unrecovered post-commit notify call (TransferSecretOwnership was already covered by #3092). Fuzz-level pin: server/faultops TestRevokeShare_CreateNotificationPanic_ReportsSuccess_3350. Red before the fix.
